title: Whole Grain Pasta with Cream Sauce, Seafood and Vegetables

content.title: About
content.content: This is a home recipe for whole‑grain pasta tossed in a smooth cream sauce with seafood (shrimp, mussels, squid) and added vegetables (broccoli, carrot, bell pepper). The dish is rich in fiber, protein and healthy fats, making it a balanced and nutritious meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑grain pasta contains more fiber and micronutrients than regular white pasta.
The cream sauce, made with cream and Parmesan, gives a velvety texture without heavy butter.
Seafood such as shrimp and mussels are excellent sources of omega‑3 fatty acids.
Quick sautéing of broccoli and carrot retains most of their vitamins.
A homemade recipe lets you control salt levels and add favorite herbs like garlic, basil, or a pinch of paprika.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain pasta supports healthy digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Seafood combined with whole grain provides a complete amino acid profile.

items.title: Omega‑3 fatty acids
items.content: Shrimp and mussels help maintain cardiovascular health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Broccoli, carrot and bell pepper supply vitamins C, K, A and potassium.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Whole‑grain pasta raises blood sugar more slowly than white pasta.

items.title: Seafood allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to shrimp, mussels or squid.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Cream sauce and added salt can increase sodium intake; adjust seasoning accordingly.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Use lactose‑free cream or a plant‑based alternative if needed.

items.title: Potential contaminants
items.content: Seafood may contain trace heavy metals; choose reputable suppliers.

content.title: How to Cook
content.content: Cook whole‑grain pasta until al dente. In a pan, sauté garlic, add seafood and cook 2‑3 minutes. Add vegetables and stir‑fry briefly. Pour in cream, add grated Parmesan, and simmer until thickened. Toss with the pasta, season with salt, pepper and fresh herbs. Serve hot.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 days. The cream sauce may separate; gently reheat and stir before serving. Do not freeze the dish with seafood, as texture may deteriorate.
